response.overview: Yes, (18663817901) Delta can be strict with carry-on baggage, especially when your bag is oversized (18663817901), too heavy (18663817901), or cannot fit properly in the overhead bin. Delta generally allows passengers to bring 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item without an additional charge (18663817901). The carry-on must meet Delta’s size requirements (18663817901), while the personal item should fit underneath the seat. On busy or full flights (18663817901), Delta may require passengers to check carry-on bags at the gate (18663817901). To avoid issues (1866381*7901), check your bag dimensions before departure and keep essential items in your personal item.
